notes.title: UPDATE && SALE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we added new things in our game: 

- [b]3 modes:[/b] easy, normal, hard.
[i]For changing difficulty mode, in "level choose" screen, press button (puzzle) in the left down side and choose difficulty (easy - green heart, normal - orange heart, hard - red heart) [/i]

- [b]2 modes:[/b] arts with censored and uncensored (For changing modes, press button (18+) in the right down side on "level choose screen")

[b]Good luck and enjoy :3 [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101260/FURRY_GIRL_PUZZLE/
